title: Probabilistic_Point_Estimations
summary: A benchmarking study comparing probabilistic regression models (TabResFlow, TTVAE, ARMD, TDGPs, TabPFN, etc.) on point-estimation accuracy across tabular datasets. The vendored TTVAE baseline implementation imports RDT's ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder transformers for its internal data preprocessing.
